name: Exc. Reigai Jishou Kanshikyoku
storyline:
This is a short, free horror game designed for chilling, conversation, relaxation, resignation, and fear—with no jump scares.

Set on a parallel Earth where humanity’s habitat has been invaded by the inexplicable phenomenon known as “exc.,” monitor and investigate “exc.” to find clues that will lead you back to the original Earth!

Don’t worry if you’re unfamiliar with this parallel world!
A capable senior will support you on your journey.
summary:
This is a point-and-click adventure game where you investigate anomalies.
The protagonist is an employee of the "Reigai Jisho Kanshi Kyoku". While monitoring and investigating unexplained phenomena known as “exc.”, they search for clues to return from a parallel Earth to the original Earth.
